name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.cutB_vecOfCut
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance),
  DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g →
    ∀ (S : List.{0} Nat) (j : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} j
          (List.length.{0}
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
        Iff
          (Eq.{1}
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.cutB
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.vecOfCut g S) j)
            Bool.true)
          (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.picks g S)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j))

source.code:
theorem cutB_vecOfCut (S : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < g.base.nodes.length) :
    cutB g.base.canonIds (g.vecOfCut S) j = true ↔ g.repOf j ∈ g.picks S := by
  unfold cutB
  have : g.base.canonIds.getD j 0 = g.repOf j := rfl
  rw [this, g.vecOfCut_getD S _ (g.repOf_lt hv j hj)]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
